user.title: WaterGenius Water Softener
user.description: Select your WaterGenius device from the list below, or choose manual entry if your device is not listed.

manual.title: Manual Device Entry
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your WaterGenius device (e.g. {example}). You can find this in your phone's Bluetooth settings while connected to the device.

mesh_credentials.title: Mesh Credentials
mesh_credentials.description: Enter the Telink mesh credentials. The defaults work for most WaterGenius devices.

error.pairing_failed: Failed to pair with device. Check mesh credentials.
